question: How do fixed source-bound spatial vegetation and forward-pollen predictions change when the exposed fifteen-site author cohort is reduced by an outcome-free geographic maximin rule to ten sites, with nine allowed source owners per held target?
scientific_consumer: Literal nine-to-one grouped execution and matched source-composition/geographic-thinning sensitivity; not isolated causal sample-size improvement or field validation.

cohort.identity_universe: All fifteen source sites and transitive physical identity families before selection. Require the qualified fifteen distinct source groups; no alias split or family truncation.
cohort.distance_model: Nominal full-precision WGS84 inverse geodesic distances between original source geometry centres, in metres; coordinate precision and footprint independence are not inferred.
cohort.seed: Minimize math.fsum of distances to all fifteen source centres, including zero self-distance; break exact ties by lexicographic record_id.
cohort.extension: Repeatedly maximize nearest-selected centre distance; break exact ties by lexicographic record_id. No rounding or tolerance before selection.
cohort.population: Geometry-only policy over the existing previously exposed author profile. Ten sites are not ten independent spatial blocks.
cohort.source_role: Group all identities, then rotate all ten selected sites once. Reapply original regional priority to the remaining nine; require the other eight local predictors.
cohort.anchor_consequence: BECKHAM exclusion changes the regional anchor: BROADOWN except held BROADOWN uses COMERSLA. This changes geography and regional-source composition together.

models.selection: Both Hellinger scales are prescribed and unselected. No new inner folds, learned parameter choice or outcome-dependent cohort; do not borrow learned full-fifteen choices as nine-owner training decisions.

source_projection.fit_custody: Authenticate qualified original packet/result/freezes/verification and original source bytes. Match each new local-anchor pair to its exact independently admitted saved request, both selected rings/attempts and native regional cover. Require all seventeen pairs; no inverse fit, kernel integration, original ensemble, random draw, archived driver or failed-run recipe is repeated.
source_projection.quantitative_ancestry: Construct new nine-owner closures. Each local fit has only its own local and regional source parents; forbid held family and all five excluded owners from new quantitative inputs. Retained full-fifteen reference ancestry remains a distinct channel. Whole-file/cache hashes are accounting only.
source_projection.forward_geometry: Use the exact target-specific qualified finite-ring kernels, original PPE, fractions, geometry and source window. Recompute new cohort interpolation and regional deposition from the selected anchor and saved outer-ring factors; weight each term once.
source_projection.axis_and_support: Keep the existing thirty-taxon parameter axis, author-TW5 calendar-BP support [1250,1750], homogeneous 1000m local support, two local rings and 100000m finite regional cutoff. No taxon, count, age, geometry or parameter substitution.
source_projection.nominal_correspondence: Reuse the unchanged independently qualified original675-slot zero-gap nominal handoff by exact input/result identity. New source projection must match saved native17-request selected vectors/regional cover and recomputed regional deposition before forecasts. Do not rerun675 old forward calls.
source_projection.reference_sources: Retain matched full-fifteen H20 predictions and three baseline predictions on the same ten targets by immutable source reference; retain original selected20 labels as full-fourteen-training history only, not a new nine-owner selection.

scoring.ordering: Close and authenticate all fifty new prediction slots and the retained-reference identities before any new scoring-role observation decode. Read each of the ten selected target outcomes once; every refused slot remains explicit.
scoring.exposure: Previously exposed development. Cached quantitative objects can contain other-fold target-derived fits; numerical candidates accept only their own allowed closure. No globally unread, OS-isolated or untouched claim.
scoring.observation: Match original raw/geometry sample identity, site, bin, calendar-BP support, exact thirty-taxon order, finite integer counts and positive observed N. N may condition scoring only.
scoring.metric_definitions: MAE is mean absolute composition difference; TV is half L1; H is sqrt(half squared root-distance). Use fractions and natural-log count-conditioned deviance; zero observed counts contribute zero, positive observed count at zero prediction is explicit infinite loss, never hidden or serialized as NaN/Infinity. With thirty taxa TV=15*MAE is an identity, not separate evidence.
scoring.comparisons: New five methods compared on identical eligible targets; retain case-level differences versus own-cohort physical baselines. Compare new methods to retained full-fifteen H20 and same-method baseline MAE/TV/H on exactly matched target/axis/observed identity. Do not rerun or pool old full-fifteen study; old count-deviance was not evaluated and remains unavailable.
scoring.summary: Report all ten grouped folds/fifty slots, eligibility/refusal and target-specific N. Equal-target descriptive averages only, with unique-grain denominator counted once per target. No winner, causal thinning effect, independent-site precision or calibrated predictive coverage is presumed.

uncertainty: Point model and fixed-scale/source-composition sensitivity only. Count/PPE/chronology/geometry/model-discrepancy uncertainty and calibrated intervals are not newly propagated; correlated nearby targets do not supply independent generalization precision. Preserve the separately qualified Nordic conditional uncertainty result in its own scope.
unsupported_claims: Actual spatial-block validation from these nearby ten sites
Calibrated uncertainty, predictive coverage or population generalization precision
Qualified biological/physical admission of all author or Nordic cores
Final scientific accuracy acceptance or guaranteed model superiority
